coreTone: Ma’at physics, visible Aten radiance, Ra kingship, Khepri renewal, Nile/Red Land duality, throne-magic, desert-storm defense, lion guardianship, hidden solar authority
thesis: Aten Ra is the older source behind humanity’s Egyptian solar religion. Human crowns, temples, ankhs, pylons, obelisks, funerary art, and divine animal masks are imperfect Earth echoes of Khepra’s living law-engine civilization.
centralConflict: The Realm survives by measuring everything against Ma’at, but the same solar order can become tyranny when Sutekh’s necessary chaos, Amunet’s hidden truth, or Iset’s mercy are cut out of the scale.
realmHazards: Aten hand-rays that burn lies into visible brands
Ma’at scale fields that immobilize anything out of balance
Khepri dawn loops that rewind wounds and revive enemies if misread
Sutekh red storms that disrupt both allies and Hollow invaders
black Nile silt channels that preserve memory and expose bloodline echoes
Amunet shadow courts that erase names from targeting until revealed
Maahes lion-gate kill zones that punish oathbreakers
campaignHooks: Recover a stolen Ma’at Feather before the Realm misjudges every allied faction
decide whether Sutekh’s storm bastion is treason or the only defense against Apep-like Hollow chaos
escort Iset priests through the Black-Land River so a shattered Titan can be restored
enter Amunet’s Hidden-Sun Archive to learn which human pharaohs copied Aten Ra Gate visions
repair the Khepri Dawn Engine before it resurrects the wrong army
defend the Maahes Lion Gate while captives marked by Isfet are judged
visualLanguage: Aten sun-discs with life-giving hand-rays, electrum collars, nemes-like light mantles, faience turquoise and lapis inlays, black Nile silt glass, red desert jasper, scarab engines, Ma’at feather geometry, solar barque arcs, pylon harnesses, lion/cobra/falcon/jackal threshold masks, lotus-papyrus river courts, and white-gold noon light.

titans.name: Aten-Ra, Solar Law Monolith
titans.loreFunction: Aten-Ra, Solar Law Monolith expresses Ra/Re + Aten + Ma’at through the defender battlefield role: Aten-Ra is the living office humans later remembered as Ra, Aten, and divine kingship fused together. He does not wear pharaoh imagery — pharaohs copied his Gate-born crown, collar, and solar hand-rays after dreaming of the Sun-Scale Gate. On the battlefield he anchors Ma’at itself, forcing chaos to declare its weight before it can pass.
titans.codexHook: When Aten-Ra, Solar Law Monolith enters a chapter, test the Solar Dominion's source-culture premise: Earth humans copied this mythic office as Egyptian divine lore, while Khepra still uses it as living Realm technology.
titans.visualContext: Myth anchor: Ra/Re + Aten + Ma’at. Armor canon: electrum-gold pylon collar, Ma’at feather scale bands, Aten sun-disc crown with life-giving hand-rays, broad judgment-shield forearms, royal linen-light mantle. Appearance: Colossal living solar judge with readable divine anatomy, an Aten sun-disc crown radiating subtle hand-like rays, electrum wesekh collar fused into chest armor, Ma’at feather balance seams, white-gold noon aura, black-lapis shadow insets, and pylon-shaped shield forearms. Must feel older than Egyptian royalty, not a statue, robot, sarcophagus, or pyramid body.

titans.name: Khemet Suncrown
titans.loreFunction: Khemet Suncrown expresses Khepri + Black Land fertility + solar renewal through the battery battlefield role: Khemet Suncrown is the Realm’s Khepri engine: the force that rolls dead light into dawn and turns Nile-black memory into power. Human scarab amulets are miniature echoes of his living renewal shell. He feeds allies by converting wounds, offerings, and battlefield heat into measured solar return.
titans.codexHook: When Khemet Suncrown enters a chapter, test the Solar Dominion's source-culture premise: Earth humans copied this mythic office as Egyptian divine lore, while Khepra still uses it as living Realm technology.
titans.visualContext: Myth anchor: Khepri + Black Land fertility + solar renewal. Armor canon: scarab-carapace back mantle, faience turquoise energy reservoirs, black Nile-silt glass abdominal plates, gold dawn crown, papyrus conduit bands. Appearance: Massive renewal-battery Titan with scarab-inspired carapace plates, faience and lapis inlay reservoirs, papyrus-green conduit veins, black Nile-silt glass core, dawn-gold crown, and slow rotating solar arcs behind the shoulders. Avoid insect monster; he is a divine generator of rebirth with clear anatomy and ceremonial mass.

titans.name: Nefra Obsidian Dawn
titans.loreFunction: Nefra Obsidian Dawn expresses Necropolis dawn + Duat horizon + obsidian judgement through the controller battlefield role: Nefra Obsidian Dawn governs the border where the sun leaves the underworld and becomes visible again. Human funerary art copied fragments of her horizon masks and dawn reliefs. She controls terrain by deciding what may cross from shadow into light.
titans.codexHook: When Nefra Obsidian Dawn enters a chapter, test the Solar Dominion's source-culture premise: Earth humans copied this mythic office as Egyptian divine lore, while Khepra still uses it as living Realm technology.
titans.visualContext: Myth anchor: Necropolis dawn + Duat horizon + obsidian judgement. Armor canon: obsidian necropolis mask, horizon-ring collar, black-gold scale skirt, dawn slit visor, limestone funerary relief plates. Appearance: Tall controller Titan of black sunrise: obsidian-blue enamel mask, thin amber dawn visor, horizon-ring collar, ivory limestone relief plates, black-gold scale armor, and angular light lanes emerging from underworld-shadow limbs. Must feel like living threshold law, not a mummy, statue, or necropolis building.

titans.name: Orru Prism Verdict
titans.loreFunction: Orru Prism Verdict expresses Ma’at weighing + prism light + divine verdict through the breaker battlefield role: Orru Prism Verdict is the punishment side of Ma’at: when something refuses balance, he refracts its hidden weight until armor, lies, and false sanctity split open. Human scales of judgement are crude courtroom copies of his prism engine.
titans.codexHook: When Orru Prism Verdict enters a chapter, test the Solar Dominion's source-culture premise: Earth humans copied this mythic office as Egyptian divine lore, while Khepra still uses it as living Realm technology.
titans.visualContext: Myth anchor: Ma’at weighing + prism light + divine verdict. Armor canon: split prism pectoral, scale-beam shoulder arcs, clear solar glass blades, electrum verdict ribs, feather-line engravings. Appearance: Breaker Titan with crystalline solar-prism chest, weighing-scale shoulder geometry, Ma’at feather linework, clear amber glass execution blades, electrum ribs, and fractured light exposing enemy weak points. Avoid generic crystal robot; the prism must feel sacred, judicial, and alive.

titans.name: Sutekh Dune Eclipse
titans.loreFunction: Sutekh Dune Eclipse expresses Set/Sutekh + Red Land desert storms + defender against chaos through the disruptor battlefield role: Sutekh Dune Eclipse is not simple evil. He is the Red Land violence Aten Ra keeps on the scale because even Ra needed Set to strike chaos from the solar journey. Humans remembered him as desert disorder; Khepra remembers him as the weapon order is afraid to admit it needs.
titans.codexHook: When Sutekh Dune Eclipse enters a chapter, test the Solar Dominion's source-culture premise: Earth humans copied this mythic office as Egyptian divine lore, while Khepra still uses it as living Realm technology.
titans.visualContext: Myth anchor: Set/Sutekh + Red Land desert storms + defender against chaos. Armor canon: red jasper storm plates, black iron-sand scars, Set-animal mask silhouette without mascot literalism, hooked khopesh arcs, sand-torn gold linen. Appearance: Disruptor Titan with red desert jasper armor, storm-sand erosion, eclipse-black solar disc behind a sharp Set-like threshold mask, hooked khopesh energy arcs, ragged gold linen, and violent asymmetry controlled by Ma’at bands. Must look dangerous and necessary, not a generic demon or villain robot.

titans.name: Iset Riverlight Throne
titans.loreFunction: Iset Riverlight Throne expresses Isis/Iset + throne magic + restoration + river afterlife passage through the sustain battlefield role: Iset Riverlight Throne is the restoration office humans later called Isis: throne, mother-protector, healer, and guide through death’s river. Her magic does not merely heal flesh; it re-seats a being in its rightful place in Ma’at.
titans.codexHook: When Iset Riverlight Throne enters a chapter, test the Solar Dominion's source-culture premise: Earth humans copied this mythic office as Egyptian divine lore, while Khepra still uses it as living Realm technology.
titans.visualContext: Myth anchor: Isis/Iset + throne magic + restoration + river afterlife passage. Armor canon: throne-shaped crown silhouette, lotus-papyrus mantle, river-glass healing channels, cow-horn/sun-disc echo used subtly, blue faience restoration plates. Appearance: Sustain Titan with a throne-silhouette crown, lotus and papyrus river mantle, blue faience and river-glass channels, soft gold sun-disc between protective horn-like arcs, linen-light veils, and restorative hand-ray patterns. Must feel protective and sovereign, not a goddess cosplay or generic healer.

titans.name: Karnu Glass Horizon
titans.loreFunction: Karnu Glass Horizon expresses Solar barque horizon + desert glass + long-range Ra sight through the artillery battlefield role: Karnu Glass Horizon is the long sight of the solar barque: he reads enemies where sky, river, and desert meet. Human obelisks and horizon sanctuaries are static imitations of his living range geometry.
titans.codexHook: When Karnu Glass Horizon enters a chapter, test the Solar Dominion's source-culture premise: Earth humans copied this mythic office as Egyptian divine lore, while Khepra still uses it as living Realm technology.
titans.visualContext: Myth anchor: Solar barque horizon + desert glass + long-range Ra sight. Armor canon: barque-arc shoulder rig, desert-glass lens array, falcon-eye sight lines, polished bronze range vanes, lapis shadow braces. Appearance: Artillery Titan with sweeping solar-barge shoulder arcs, desert-glass lens organs, falcon-eye targeting visor, bronze horizon vanes, lapis braces, and mirage-light cannon geometry grown from the body. Avoid sci-fi sniper/mech; every range element should feel like sacred astronomy made alive.

titans.name: Maahes Noon Bastion
titans.loreFunction: Maahes Noon Bastion expresses Maahes lion war-protection + knives + lotus + devouring captives through the guardian battlefield role: Maahes Noon Bastion carries the lion war-protection humans later carved as Maahes and Sekhmet-adjacent temple guardians. He is the noon gate’s living roar: mercy behind him, knives before him, captives judged in his shadow.
titans.codexHook: When Maahes Noon Bastion enters a chapter, test the Solar Dominion's source-culture premise: Earth humans copied this mythic office as Egyptian divine lore, while Khepra still uses it as living Realm technology.
titans.visualContext: Myth anchor: Maahes lion war-protection + knives + lotus + devouring captives. Armor canon: lion-mane solar collar, knife-fin bracers, lotus-and-bronze guard plates, sun-red war marks, heavy guardian forelimb armor. Appearance: Guardian Titan with lion-mane gold collar, leonine but readable humanoid-divine anatomy, knife-like bronze bracers, lotus crest, sun-red war markings, massive intercepting forearms, and heat-haze roar aura. Avoid furry beastman or generic lion monster; he is royal protective violence.

titans.name: Amunet Hidden Sun
titans.loreFunction: Amunet Hidden Sun expresses Amunet + hidden sun + concealed names + unseen breath through the assassin battlefield role: Amunet Hidden Sun is the concealed half of Aten authority: the breath, name, and shadow behind visible radiance. Humans remembered hidden gods as mystery; Khepra built entire courts around the terror of a name removed from the sun.
titans.codexHook: When Amunet Hidden Sun enters a chapter, test the Solar Dominion's source-culture premise: Earth humans copied this mythic office as Egyptian divine lore, while Khepra still uses it as living Realm technology.
titans.visualContext: Myth anchor: Amunet + hidden sun + concealed names + unseen breath. Armor canon: veil-like black-gold linen, hidden sun-disc under hood/crown, obsidian name-blades, negative-space ankh forms, starless lapis cloak. Appearance: Assassin Titan wrapped in black-gold linen-light veils, concealed solar disc under a shadow crown, obsidian name-blades, lapis void cloak, negative-space sacred forms, and faint hand-rays visible only at edges. Must be elegant and mythic, not ninja, robot assassin, or generic shadow demon.

coreTone: storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.
thesis: Asgardians are the source behind human Norse saga: oath, storm, world-root, raven wisdom, Valkyrie death-law, and Ragnarok pressure made living. They must feel older than Viking imagery; human longhalls, runes, shields, funeral rites, and storm gods are echoes of this realm.
centralConflict: A vow is not language to Asgardians; it is weather, weapon, bloodline, and law. Oath held becomes power. Oath broken becomes storm judgment.
realmHazards: runes that bind promises into flesh
lightning that strikes cowardice before armor
world-root snare paths that remember old betrayals
blackwinter gusts that slow the oathless
raven omen swarms that reveal hidden names
wolf-teeth fractures opening under broken shield lines
feast-fire resurrection echoes that return dead enemies if honor rites are ignored
campaignHooks: prove whether The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds should preserve its ancient law or adapt it before the Hollow exploits it
recover a source-culture relic humans later misunderstood in Earth myth
defend a landmark that keeps the Realm's myth-function alive
expose a human legend as a distorted memory of Gate contact

thesis: Olympians are the source behind human Greek myth: contest, polis, prophecy, marble, bronze, sky law, divine politics, and victory made bodily. They should feel like the original court of gods that humans later carved into temples and epics.
centralConflict: Excellence is sacred only when witnessed. Olympian power is trial, beauty, rivalry, law, and victory turned into divine physics.
realmHazards: laurel verdict rings that punish cowardice and hubris
oracle vapors that reveal possible futures as traps
thunder tribunals that strike illegal movement
marble terraces that fall when contests are dishonored
aegis glare that petrifies reckless attackers
forge sparks that arm whoever proves worthy
sea-quake tremors under cloud foundations

coreTone: torii silhouettes, shrine lacquer red, white paper shide, braided shimenawa cords, mirror discs, foxfire blue, ink-wash smoke, cedar bark, moonlit silk, oni iron, tengu feather wind, dragon-rain scales, mask geometry, seasonal petals and ash.
thesis: Kami are the source behind human Japanese spirit lore: shrine threshold, nature divinity, masks, foxfire, purification, dragon rain, and twilight yōkai law made living. Designs must feel sacred and uncanny, not anime samurai costumes.
centralConflict: Every boundary is alive. Kami power is respect for the threshold between human, spirit, nature, memory, and storm.
